note: Jasper County TX has no county zoning (Texas counties do not zone; assessor guide says no centralized zoning). The county's ArcGIS parcel layers (e.g. Jasper_CAD_TX_Parcels) carry no zoning field. City of Silsbee publishes its zoning map only as a PDF. No queryable zoning district service found for City of Jasper or Kirbyville. The 'jasper.county.codes' zoning page is Jasper County, Indiana, not relevant.
